_comment: MERGE these keys into an existing ~/.claude/settings.json — never replace
the file. It already holds plugins, model choice and permissions that must
survive. Back it up to a timestamped copy before touching it.
autoCompactWindow: how full the context window gets before Claude Code
auto-compacts, IN TOKENS. Legal range 100000-1000000. When unset, Claude
Code uses a window tuned for the model, which is much higher — around 967K
for Sonnet 5 on the 1M context window. Setting 300000 therefore compacts
substantially EARLIER than stock. The trade is real and it goes both ways:
a shorter live context in exchange for materially lower cost per session.
Raise it (e.g. 500000) if you find yourself losing context you needed;
delete the key entirely to go back to the model default.
autoCompactEnabled must stay true — autoCompactWindow does nothing without
